correctness.rationale: Direct idempotent recovery from the lift z=λe_v+ℓ uses z²−2λz=−λ²e_v, which is valid in characteristic two because ℓ²=0. Peirce decomposition and the J²=0 product rule are necessary and sufficient for ideal closure. Each distinct support/block-rank product of ordinary Grassmannians embeds as a disjoint closed subvariety; these exhaust the geometric points and hence the reduction. Gaussian subspace counts prove every coefficient. The direct original-multiplication checker exhaustively compares all subspaces for 22 finite-field/quiver cases, including true GF(4). Boundary conventions: loops/parallel arrows and arbitrary fields are included; no claim of original scheme reducedness.

value.rationale: The entire lattice and all dimensional strata of two-sided ideals are intrinsic structural invariants of each truncated quiver algebra. The result classifies their geometry and exact arithmetic for every finite quiver, and proves that orientation changes preserve the full ideal lattice for orientations of simple graphs even while the algebras need not be isomorphic; the explicit two-arrow boundary shows the phenomenon is not tautological in the wider family. These are complete natural classifications, not arbitrary finite slices.
